component.name: Signal Bridge
component.summary: End-to-end encrypted private chat for Fancy Mumble

description.p: Adds end-to-end encrypted private chat to Fancy Mumble, using the Signal Protocol's Sender Keys for group messages. With this add-on installed, private conversations are encrypted on your machine and the server relays ciphertext it cannot read.

It is packaged separately because it builds on libsignal-protocol, which is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3, while Fancy Mumble itself is MIT-licensed. Installing this add-on is what puts AGPL-licensed code on your system; without it, Fancy Mumble runs normally and encrypted private chat is simply unavailable.
